//: Overhaul Prompt 10: shipboard resources (docs/gameplay-overhaul/14-resources-and-cooking.md). Opt-in: nothing here happens until a script switches the system on ({ "suppliesSystem": true }), and no chapter does. Items are the ordinary items of data/items (one inventory); this file says what they are for, where they come from, where the ship keeps them, what can be worn and what the galley cooks.
//classes: Every functional resource, once: repair materials (the repairs' bills), emergency supplies, ingredients (the galley's), food (eaten from the Items menu), consumables, and protective gear (worn, never used up). A story item that is none of these (Frog Grog, the rum ration that becomes it, the key items) is never taken by this system: an item a story step takes or swaps can't be classed (the validator checks).
//stores: The ship's shared stores: deposit and withdraw standing at them (at: the props' tiles, reach in tiles), never more than 'capacity' units in all, only the classes it 'accepts' (never a key item). Repairs pay from what the captain carries, never from here: he fetches. 'spend': the actions that may also draw on the stores, and the rooms they may do it from (the cook sends down to the hold from the galley).
//sources: Where supplies come from, by hand, in the rooms (no remote menu). type: cache (searched: seconds of work, no bar), salvage (pried loose on the timing bar: success gives all, partial its share, a failure a knock), recovery (always there, small, a cooldown after each: the way back from empty). uses: how many times it gives before it is empty (recovery: unlimited). restock: { every (seconds of hazard time), add, max, when? }. when: a condition for it to be there at all. Its state (what is left, the restock and cooldown clocks) is saved and checkpointed: leaving the room, reloading or retrying never refills it.
//gear: Protective gear: story items given a use while worn, one to a slot, put on and taken off by hand (Respond, or a script), never by itself. Worn gear stays in the pack (a story check for it still finds it; nothing can sell, store or cook it). Its effects on the beard and the lungs are the beard's (data/ship/beard.json equipment); here: the slot, what it can't be worn with, a knock's share (the helmet), and charges (the cloth works while it is wet: it dries while he breathes bad air, and is wetted again at water).

beard_wrap.note: Keeps the beard from soaking: it catches less.

wet_cloth.note: Filters what reaches the lungs while it is wet.

bottle_goggles.note: Keeps the sting of a gassy beard out of the eyes.

clay_pot_helmet.note: Takes the edge off a knock while salvaging.
clay_pot_helmet.notWithReason: Bob's Pot comes down over the goggles.

//effects: Timed effects of food and draughts, on the hazard clock (saved). One per group at a time: a new meal replaces the last meal's, the same one again only restarts its clock (never stacks). work: emergency work takes this much as long; hurt: the share of bad air's harm he takes; zone: pixels added to a repair, salvage or cooking bar's green zone (negative: shakier hands); lungs: what reaches his lungs (a draught: taken with the Frog Grog ward, the smaller, never on top). Bounded by limits.

steady_hands.label: Steady hands
steady_hands.note: A wider green on the repair bars.

warm_belly.label: Warm belly
warm_belly.note: Bad air hurts him half as much.

grog_ward.label: Grog-warded
grog_ward.note: Less gets to the lungs; the hands wobble.

//stations: The galley's cooking station: the stove (standing next to it).
//recipes: Galley recipes: ingredients (from the pack, and the stores where they may be spent), the stir on the timing bar (success: 'serves.success' portions, partial fewer; a failure scorches it: its 'waste' is lost, a cost a retry keeps, and nothing cooks), then 'seconds' of work and 'simmer' seconds of hazard time before it can be served (he can leave it). One pot at a time. known: false for a recipe a script teaches (learnRecipe).
